title: New Orleans EF3 Tornado Response
description: B-Roll of La. National Guard's 1st Battalion, 141 Field Artillery Regiment providing support to the New Orleans Police Department in the aftermath of an EF3 tornado that struck parts of New Orleans East.
keywords: LANG, SouthernTornado17, Emergency Response, Louisiana National Guard

transcript.text: So right now we're utilizing the guard with static patrols, static positions, excuse me,
where they're sitting at these locations and actually interacting with the citizens of those
neighborhoods, making sure that the people who actually live in those neighborhoods have access
to the neighborhoods. Okay, so one for one's got an opportunity this evening at a request from
the governor's office of Homeland Security to come out and support NOPD, support New Orleans East,
in providing some immediate security and safety in the wake of the tornado that occurred this
afternoon. We're going to provide static security, so some thick site locations, some traffic control
points, and by allowing a guardsman to perform that role, we're freeing up a law enforcement officer,
who probably has some additional skill sets of training and law enforcement to go do roving
patrols, counter looting, respond to calls, you know, of things that police officers need to be doing.
So we're enabling NOPD and the other police agencies and sheriff's offices that are responding here
to be better employed for the people of New Orleans East.
